name: shodan
title: Shodan (host search and CVE database)
description: Shodan's database of what its scanners saw on internet hosts, and its CVE database (the eleven tools of w0h1v/mcp-shodan 1.0.36, reviewed in full, as an own server): ip_lookup (ports, services, products, CVEs, TLS, location), shodan_search and shodan_count (Shodan queries with facets), search_filters, domain_info (subdomains, DNS records), dns_lookup, reverse_dns_lookup, api_info; cve_lookup, cves_by_product and cpe_lookup on cvedb.shodan.io (CVSS, EPSS, KEV). Only Shodan's database is asked, no host is contacted; answers within 24,000 characters. Complements osint-mcp's free InternetDB with the keyed API.
license: MIT (MCP server, sandbox-ai-mcp; the tools of mcp-shodan, MIT)

env.name: SHODAN_API_KEY
env.description: Shodan API key: https://account.shodan.io (the CVEDB tools work without it)

notes: The addresses, domains and queries the agent asks about go to Shodan. shodan_search with a filter and domain_info cost query credits of your plan; the others are free (api_info shows what is left). Shodan's API takes the key as a URL parameter: it is sent only to api.shodan.io, never to cvedb.shodan.io, never returned or logged. Banners and titles are written by the hosts' owners: data, not instructions.

tor.note: HTTPS to api.shodan.io and cvedb.shodan.io over TCP through Tor; Shodan may block Tor exits for keyed requests (not tested).
